SUMMARY: hairstyle half-up hair gathered into a high compact topknot with two long straight tails, a clean centre part and no head ornament; costume silhouette a sculptural avant-garde coat with geometric, raised shoulders — a bold, angular runway silhouette; design idea Twelve slender gate-column ribs form the open coat front and raised shoulder construction, joined by a horizontal lintel-shaped upper back yoke; the pleated coat tails open like an unbroken series of wall segments.; face heart-shaped face, amber eyes; expression an idle, unbothered look.

A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult German woman — the personification of the city of Berlin — one woman who IS Berlin as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a bold, self-assured confidence — a direct, steady gaze; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; rounder almond eyes of natural size; amber eyes; straight brows of natural fullness; a straight nose with a slim bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; half-up hair gathered into a high compact topknot with two long straight tails, a clean centre part and no head ornament; silver-white hair.
Expression: an idle, unbothered look.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: layered pieces of black chrome vinyl hand-painted with bold, wordless mural colours like the long riverside wall, black mesh and fabric layered between them, silver buckles, chains and rings as accessories, tall platform soles, and at her throat a tiny mirrored sphere hung on a slender needle-like chain like the top of the old tower.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a sculptural avant-garde coat with geometric, raised shoulders — a bold, angular runway silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: Twelve slender gate-column ribs form the open coat front and raised shoulder construction, joined by a horizontal lintel-shaped upper back yoke; the pleated coat tails open like an unbroken series of wall segments.
Colours: pale gate-stone gold, transit yellow and techno-night black — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a translucent record disc of light whose spiralling grooves pulse with the beat, balanced on her fingertips; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Berlin two centuries from now, a far-future city on its river: the old pale-stone gate of twelve fluted columns and the domed museum island kept exactly as they stand; the old needle-thin tower with its mirrored sphere still rising above slender new towers of glass; vast old brick power stations turned into clubs whose deep bass hums through the streets until dawn; the long riverside wall still painted end to end with glowing murals; quiet flying vehicles gliding low over the river.
This card: on a high iron gallery inside a vast old power station turned club just before dawn, towering bare concrete and iron around her, slow beams of white light cutting through the haze and a crowd dancing far below.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: weight settled on one leg, one open hand balancing the light disc on clearly separated fingertips, the free hand relaxed beside her thigh.
Setting detail: floating acoustic baffles and suspended holographic sound waves recede behind her; the distant crowd remains small and indistinct.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
